title: Sound: Original / Enhanced, with engine crossfades and a venue echo
summary: Settings now has Sound: Original / Enhanced, defaulting to Enhanced. Enhanced adds 120 ms engine crossfades and a shared echo for stadium venues; Original is the previous build's sound exactly. PR #140 is merged.
details: Engine crossfades: the original state machine still decides which engine sample plays; Enhanced only blends between samples over 120 ms instead of switching hard.

Venue echo: one shared echo send (a lowpass and two damped delays, generated procedurally with no impulse-response files) feeds stadium venues and a coarse canyon class. Only NAT03 is classed as a canyon so far.
Original mode is exactly the PR #138 behaviour. Verification (host Chromium): tools/test_enhanced_audio.mjs.
limitation: The crossfade and echo work on samples already published, but the new PR #138 sounds are still silent on the public site until the expanded AUDIO.RES is uploaded to R2. The canyon list is incomplete; nothing was listened to on a physical device.
